##### Project general facts

Sunny Moon is a luxury condominium development by Sunny Development Group, a company with over a decade of construction experience and successful projects across seven countries. This multi-award-winning project features low-rise buildings offering studios, one, two, and three-bedroom residences, as well as exclusive penthouses. Every detail has been thoughtfully considered to provide maximum comfort, blending refined design with natural materials such as wood, stone, and textiles.

Residents enjoy an extensive range of world-class amenities designed for body, mind, and soul. The complex features a swimming pool, a fitness center, a spa and sauna, a panoramic rooftop sauna, an art-style rooftop terrace, a restaurant and bar, an Ayurvedic center, a cinema, a game zone with VR space and billiards, a children’s room, a library, co-working spaces, a podcast and recording studio, and a playground. An innovative water filtration system, solar panels, and electric car charging stations reflect a commitment to sustainability and modern living.

Every residence at Sunny Moon is crafted with natural materials and contemporary aesthetics, creating a harmonious blend of comfort and style. Spacious layouts feature open-plan living areas, fully appointed kitchens, and elegant bathrooms. Large windows flood the interiors with natural light, while private terraces offer serene views. The design emphasizes refinement and tranquility, making each home a sanctuary of balance and inspiration. An in-house furniture production ensures exceptional quality and attention to detail.

##### Parking
Shared and private parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the peaceful Rawai area of southern Phuket, this exceptional location places residents just a short stroll from Nai Harn Beach, one of the island’s most beloved and pristine shores. According to travelers, Nai Harn is ranked among the top five beaches in Asia, renowned for its golden sands, crystal-clear waters, and relaxed atmosphere.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional convenience and natural beauty. A scenic lake with walking paths is just minutes away, while restaurants, spas, massage parlors, markets, schools, kindergartens, and children’s parks are all within easy reach. Nearby attractions include stunning viewpoints, yoga studios, and cultural landmarks such as the Big Buddha.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal elegance, tranquility, and strong investment potential, Rawai delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of pristine beaches, five-star amenities, and a peaceful, sophisticated address makes it one of Phuket’s most desirable locations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of island living — serene, refined and effortlessly connected.
